annotations.title: Look up a U.S. federal contractor (SAM entity)

description:
Find a company registered to do business with the U.S. government by 12-character SAM UEI, 5-character CAGE code, or name (substring match). Returns legal and DBA name, UEI, CAGE, location, website, NAICS codes, small-business flags (SB, WOSB, VOSB, SDVOSB, HUBZone, 8(a)), SAM registration status and expiry, lifetime federal award count and value, most recent award and parent company, largest award value first.
FREE tier: 20 calls per visitor per 24h. A GlobalGov plan with API access lifts the cap.
